name: Maui County, HI
findings: Maui County has 540 nonprofit organizations. 229 of them (42%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 177 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (19% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Maui County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Housing organizations stand out for public events
observations.text: 13 housing organizations here list public events, compared with about 2 in similar places of this size.

observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in Maui County list civic or political action in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 68% of the typical level).
